sentences: VCC and EXEC are wave-wide registers, but one invocation holds only its own lane's bit.
`s_cbranch_vccz/vccnz/execz/execnz` therefore reduce the condition across the subgroup (`OpGroupNonUniformAny`), so the whole wave takes the branch together, as on hardware.
Before this, each lane decided alone.
A lane could skip scalar instructions that the hardware wave executes (its SGPRs went stale for later code), and cross-lane ops or barriers inside the block saw a split wave.
`v_cmp`/`v_cmp_class`/64-bit compares now write 0 for inactive lanes (hardware VOPC behaviour), so the reduction sees the true mask.
GPU-checked with `runtime/test/shaders/ps_uniform_branch.asm`: lanes whose own VCC bit is 0 run the block's scalar add when their wave has any set bit.
`s_cbranch_scc0/1` stay per lane; SCC is uniform as long as the SGPRs feeding it are.
